How this estimate works

For an owner-occupied home with one or two units and a traditional down payment. Fixed interest is compounded semi-annually, with regular monthly, biweekly or weekly payments. Biweekly and weekly options are not accelerated payments.

For eligible insured purchases below $1.5 million, this calculator applies CMHC premiums of 4.00%, 3.10% or 2.80%, depending on the loan-to-value ratio. An eligible insured 30-year amortization adds 0.20 percentage points to the premium. At 20% down or more, no borrower-paid default insurance is estimated.

Ontario’s 8% tax on the insurance premium is shown separately and is not financed. Property taxes, home insurance, legal fees, land transfer taxes, adjustments and other closing costs are excluded. Insurance and lender qualification still apply; this is an estimate, not an offer or approval.

Method and rules reviewed November 9, 2026. Your numbers stay in your browser.
